-- notices：首页公告、通知详情 INSERT INTO notices (id, title, content, type, is_urgent, publish_time, create_id, create_by, create_time, status, del_flag, remark) SELECT 900001, '紧急通知：五一期间「把自己产品化」线下站席位变动', '受场地容量与嘉宾排期调整影响，深圳站将新增5个共创席位，并同步开放线上连线位。请已报名同学在活动前48小时确认出行安排。', 'system', true, NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day', 1, 'admin', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day', '0', 0, 'C端演示数据' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notices WHERE id = 900001); -- event_info：首页热门、活动列表、活动详情 INSERT INTO event_info ( id, title, join_type, category, start_time, end_time, join_deadline, max_participants, registered_count, checked_in_count, location, address, city, cover_image_url, list_image_url, detail_image_url, poster_image_url, biz_status, is_public, base_points_reward, event_price, event_type, target_audience, learning_objectives, curriculum, event_tags, organizer, contact, pm_user_id, text1, create_id, create_by, create_time, status, del_flag, remark ) SELECT 910001, '把自己产品化 · 深圳站', 'OFFLINE', 'WORKSHOP', NOW() + INTERVAL '7 day', NOW() + INTERVAL '7 day 6 hour', NOW() + INTERVAL '5 day', 120, 86, 0, '深圳 · 南山科兴科学园', '深圳市南山区科苑路15号', '深圳', 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1515187029135-18ee286d815b?w=1200', 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1552664730-d307ca884978?w=1200', 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1552664730-d307ca884978?w=1200,https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1521737604893-d14cc237f11d?w=1200', 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1492684223066-81342ee5ff30?w=1200', 'PUBLISHED', true, 30, 2999.0000, 'OFFLINE_COURSE', '成长型创始人、IP主理人、转型教练', '产品化思维重构,商业定位拆解,一对一方案诊断,共创落地清单', '["产品化思维底层逻辑","个人商业画布拆解","流量与信任转换路径","案例共创与行动清单"]'::jsonb, 'PRODUCTIZE,OFFLINE,COCREATION', '十倍好成长运营中心', 'assistant@better10.com', 1, '

本场为沉浸式线下课程，聚焦“从经验输出到产品化交付”的完整路径。

你将带走可复用的定位模板、课程包装模板与成交话术框架。

', 1, 'admin', NOW() - INTERVAL '2 day', '0', 0, 'C端演示数据' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event_info WHERE id = 910001); INSERT INTO event_info ( id, title, join_type, category, start_time, end_time, join_deadline, max_participants, registered_count, checked_in_count, location, address, city, cover_image_url, list_image_url, detail_image_url, poster_image_url, biz_status, is_public, base_points_reward, event_price, event_type, target_audience, learning_objectives, curriculum, event_tags, organizer, contact, pm_user_id, text1, create_id, create_by, create_time, status, del_flag, remark ) SELECT 910002, '实修工作坊 · 上海站', 'OFFLINE', 'WORKSHOP', NOW() + INTERVAL '14 day', NOW() + INTERVAL '14 day 5 hour', NOW() + INTERVAL '12 day', 80, 42, 0, '上海 · 徐汇滨江', '上海市徐汇区龙腾大道188号', '上海', 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1505373877841-8d25f7d46678?w=1200', 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1511578314322-379afb476865?w=1200', 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1511578314322-379afb476865?w=1200', 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1464375117522-1311d6a5b81f?w=1200', 'PUBLISHED', true, 20, 1999.0000, 'OFFLINE_COURSE', '教培讲师、咨询顾问、内容创业者', '认知重构,案例复盘,小组共创', '["认知重构工作坊","案例拆解与演练","导师答疑与复盘"]'::jsonb, 'GROWTH,WORKSHOP,PRACTICE', '十倍好成长运营中心', 'service@better10.com', 1, '

', 1, 'admin', NOW() - INTERVAL '4 day', '0', 0, 'C端演示数据' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event_info WHERE id = 910002); -- knowledge_content：成长/搜索/详情页 INSERT INTO knowledge_content ( id, title, subtitle, content, content_type, author_id, tags, biz_status, publish_time, view_count, like_count, comment_count, share_count, collect_count, ai_summary, promotional_text, text2, text3, create_id, create_by, create_time, status, del_flag, remark ) SELECT 920001, '蛋壳理论：从内打破是生命', '探讨个体成长的内生动力', '从“蛋壳”隐喻出发，解释外部刺激与内部觉察的关系，给出可执行的日更训练方法。', 'WIKI', 1, '蛋壳理论,自我成长,方法论', 'PUBLISHED', NOW() - INTERVAL '10 day', 1280, 36, 9, 14, 21, '从内在驱动力构建稳定成长系统。', '高密度实修框架，帮助你建立长期行动惯性。', 'https://example.com/bt10/wiki/egg-shell-v3.pdf', '实操手册 V3.2', 1, 'admin', NOW() - INTERVAL '10 day', '0', 0, 'C端演示数据' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_content WHERE id = 920001);
